_readme: Drake W2 screen setup. field_order = Tab order on the screen (use __SKIP__ to tab past a field). Confirm with: python run.py calibrate --form W2. field_ids/focus_check are written by: python run.py map-fields --form W2. label_overrides lets you match Drake's exact wording in the tracker. keys overrides settings.json keys for this screen only (e.g. open_existing_extra: keys needed if Drake shows a list of existing W-2s when the screen opens).
